source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of November 5, 2026, there were 151,681,991 shares of the Company's common stock outstanding.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on the NYSE as SPCE. The count roughly doubled during 2026 (81,409,340 at March 31, 2026) through at-the-market sales, the redemption and exchange of convertible debt for shares and pre-funded warrants, and the exercise of those warrants; the Q3 2026 equity statement shows 10,310,868 pre-funded warrants exercised in the third quarter. Any warrants still unexercised are not counted.
